app.name: WC04 Camera (experimental)
app.long_description: Experimental UVC photo capture for the 057e:030a WC04 camera. Requires IOS58 and writable SD. A captures, 1 selects 320x240 or 640x480, 2 scans, HOME exits. This version initializes stream negotiation from camera-provided parameters and retains timestamped packet diagnostics. Earlier testing received headers without image payload; successful photo capture remains unverified. No live viewfinder. If cancellation waits for USB, unplug the camera to release the transfer.
